name: isolated-devcontainers-suede
description: Dev-only manifest. NOT shipped -- release/ is the shipped tree and carries no package.json. It pins ESM resolution for the .ts files node runs during tests, pins the TypeScript that type-checks them, and gives the suite memorable entry points. Vitest is pinned at 5.0.3: 5.1 hands plugins root-relative ids, which suede.nests's collector does not resolve (its generated test modules are 'not found').
